visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a striped button-down shirt (Joeman) walks across a stage toward a white wall featuring text that reads "NEW MODEL Y LAUNCH SERIES." He gestures with his right hand toward the rear bumper of a dark grey Tesla parked on a black floor. The lighting is bright and industrial with red stage lights visible. (2) A close-up shot focuses on a small, rectangular badge on the car's body, displaying a white sunburst pattern against a dark background. The car's metallic grey texture is visible in high detail. (3) Joeman stands in front of a reflective silver wall with a large Tesla logo, speaking to the camera with high-energy facial expressions and hand gestures. A circular inset shows another man wearing a mask and a beige shirt. (4) Consecutive shots display car features: a white sunburst pattern projected onto the carpeted floor from an open door, and a black door sill plate engraved with the words "LAUNCH SERIES." (5) Joeman is seated in the driver's seat, pointing with his index finger toward the large, central infotainment screen. People are visible through the car's window in the background. (6) The car's screen displays a stylized animation of red and white light streaks converging in a tunnel-like effect. (7) A man in a beige shirt and a black mask (Apple Dad) faces the camera, bowing slightly with his hands pressed together in a gesture of gratitude or celebration.
